import importlib.util,json,statistics,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'scripts'))
from validation_support import command,clean_environment,save_json,sha
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('lb',root/'scripts/logue-bench.py');lb=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(lb)
work=Path('/tmp/birnam-collection-search');baseline=work/'baseline';candidate=work/'simplified'
original=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','HEAD:examples/logue/logue-core.birnam'],text=True)
authored=(root/'examples/logue/logue-core.birnam').read_text()
cfg=dict(phase='arena',seed=12345,width=16,monsters=8,turns=16,batches=4,samples=3,allocation=False,replace=False)
for name,source in [('original',original),('fold',authored),('search',authored)]:
 d=work/('app-'+name);d.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
 (d/'logue-core.birnam').write_text(source)
 (d/'logue-bench.birnam').write_text((root/'examples/logue/logue-bench.birnam').read_text())
 (d/'run.birnam').write_text('[Globals at: #LogueBenchConfig put: '+lb.literal(cfg)+'];\n[System load: "logue-bench.birnam"]')
report={'driver':Path(__file__).read_text(),'application_sources':{'original':original,'detect':authored},'config':cfg,'runs':[]}
for variant in ['original','fold','search','search','fold','original']:
 prefix=candidate if variant=='search' else baseline
 run=command([prefix/'bin/birnam','run.birnam'],cwd=work/('app-'+variant),env=clean_environment(),timeout=180)
 assert run['exit_code']==0 and not run['stderr'],run
 lines=run['stdout'].splitlines();assert lines[0]=='[logue-core] loaded'
 results=json.loads(lines[1]);lb.check_report(results,cfg)
 samples=[b['cpu_ns'] for s in results['results'] for b in s]
 report['runs'].append(dict(variant=variant,samples=samples,results=results,checked=True))
 save_json(work/'app-bench.json',report)
 print(variant,statistics.median(samples)/1e6,flush=True)
report['median_cpu_ns']={v:statistics.median(n for r in report['runs'] if r['variant']==v for n in r['samples']) for v in ['original','fold','search']}
save_json(work/'app-bench.json',report)
